summary.claim_boundary: R9 CV feature-extrapolation probe only compares locked leave-one-target-out residual rows against the feature distribution available in each training fold. It does not train new production models, rewrite scores, write reviewed metric payloads, approve receipts, promote canonical intake, change production scoring, run docking/MD, download, upload, email, delete, commit, push, or mutate external state.
